init.title: Adaptive Light
init.description: The zone, or a momentary action on this entry.

zone.title: Zone
zone.description: One zone, on its own. When any presence sensor turns on, these lamps turn on. When all of them have been off for the timeout, the lamps turn off. Night mode, during its window, turns them off after an hour without new movement and turns them on again when movement returns. Brightness and color are not changed. Another zone is added as another entry.

momentary.title: Momentary action
momentary.description: On trigger the lamp's current state is saved, the color is applied, and after the duration the snapshot is restored or the lamp turns off. A sensor or button trigger already stored on this action is kept.
